_comment: Copy the "Mudbase" section below into MudbaseShowcase.Kanban/appsettings.Development.json (or set the equivalent Mudbase__<Key> environment variables in production) with your own provisioned project's values. None of these are secrets - a project/collection/board id is not sensitive, see README.md.

Mudbase._comment_boardId: Single shared board id - this is a single-board demo, not multi-tenant. Must be a real 24-hex-char ObjectId (the id of the one document in a small `boards` collection) - see plan/build-plan.md for why a slug like "main-board" is rejected by Mudbase's query sanitizer.
